title: VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience
abstract: arXiv:2608.16544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to encode task knowledge, tool-use procedures, and validation rules. Existing skill self-evolution methods primarily revise skills using execution trajectories collected from current tasks, leaving the evolution knowledge accumulated in public skill version histories largely untapped. Our pilot study reveals a clear complementarity between the two sources: public skill changes provide reusable evolution priors, whereas trajectories provide evidence grounded in the current task. Motivated by this, we propose VCE-Skill, which distills noisy and implementation-specific public skill changes into reusable, structured version-change experience and adaptively fuses it with trajectory-derived proposals from the base evolver, thereby exploiting external experience while retaining task-specific evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VCE-Skill improves skill self-evolution, increasing mean sco

translated_title: VCE-Skill：利用版本变更经验增强技能自我进化
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16544v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：智能体越来越依赖可复用技能来编码任务知识、工具使用流程和验证规则。现有的技能自我进化方法主要利用当前任务收集的执行轨迹来修订技能，而公开技能版本历史中积累的进化知识大多未被利用。我们的初步研究揭示了这两种来源之间的明显互补性：公开的技能变更提供了可复用的进化先验，而轨迹则提供了基于当前任务的实证证据。基于此，我们提出了VCE-Skill，该方法将嘈杂且特定于实现的公开技能变更提炼为可复用的结构化版本变更经验，并自适应地将其与基础进化器生成的轨迹推导建议融合，从而在保留任务特定证据的同时利用外部经验。大量实验表明，VCE-Skill提升了技能自我进化能力，平均得分有所提高。
tldr: VCE-Skill通过提炼公开技能版本历史中的可复用进化经验，并与当前任务轨迹融合，显著提升了智能体的技能自我进化性能。
en_tdlr: VCE-Skill enhances agent skill self-evolution by distilling reusable evolution experience from public skill version histories and adaptively fusing it with current-task trajectory evidence.
